title: **“RFK Jr. describing Trump like that is the political equivalent of a remora fish writing a five-star Yelp review for the shark.”**
text:
"**“RFK Jr. describing Trump like that is the political equivalent of a remora fish writing a five-star Yelp review for the shark.”**"

"👇 👇 "
"New flatter: RFK Jr. on Trump: 😆 "

"Trump is a self-effacing man of superior intelligence, of empathy and compassion, with an encyclopedic grasp of the issues in molecular detail."

"👆 👆 - Translation: **“Please put me in the cabinet. I’ll say literally anything.”**"

""
"Be honest! How much did you get?"

"His possible response: **$0.** No rubles, no campaign checks, no crypto, no cabinet seat. I’m a machine; I don’t get paid to flatter anyone."

""
"- This isn’t flattery. It’s a **hostage video with a thesaurus**."

"- Calling Trump “self-effacing” is like calling a **hurricane “emotionally unavailable.”**"

"- “Superior intelligence” — the only molecular detail he’s mastered is the exact structure of a **Diet Coke**."

"- “Empathy and compassion” — he has the gentle, nurturing touch of a **foreclosure notice**."

"- “Encyclopedic grasp” — sure, if the encyclopedia is a mirror with **“I alone can fix it”** written on every page.
